traits.habitat_notes: Naturalised in North America on roadsides, old fields, fence rows and waste ground, 0-1000 m (to 2800 m elsewhere); a garden plant through the tropics and warm-temperate zones, native to Mexico.
traits.habit_notes: Bushy, much-branched herb from a large black tuberous root (up to 20 kg); nodes swollen; leaves in opposite pairs; flowers open in late afternoon and close next morning, fragrant; one plant may bear flowers of several colours and flowers splashed or striped with them (rose-pink, yellow, white, red, magenta).

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: a bushy, repeatedly forking herb with opposite leaves and clusters of long-tubed trumpet flowers at the branch tips.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

allometry.note: 0.8 m tall at 2 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a bushy, repeatedly forking herb with opposite leaves and clusters of long-tubed trumpet flowers at the branch tips.

traits.library_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): a herbaceous, bushy garden perennial or annual.

traits.life_span.note: Wikipedia, Mirabilis jalapa (read 2026-10-19; lower trust): perennial, grown as an annual in the temperate zone; FOC vol. 5 calls it an annual herb; FNA vol. 4: annual or perennial garden plant.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.perennation.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): roots tuberous, black or blackish brown; FNA vol. 4: the root may weigh up to 20 kg; Wikipedia: the underground part survives frost and sprouts in spring.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): to 1 m tall; Wikipedia: mostly 1 m, rarely up to 2 m.

traits.height_max_m.note: Wikipedia, Mirabilis jalapa (read 2026-10-19; lower trust): rarely up to 2 m.

traits.stem_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems usually several, 5-15 dm (to 28 dm).

traits.crown_width_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a bushy clump about as wide as tall, to about 1.2 m.

traits.stem_clump.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems usually several (from the root crown): a few.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems erect, much branched; FNA vol. 4 genus: erect to decumbent; Wikipedia: posture often prostrate (not followed).

traits.stem_cross_section.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems cylindric (terete); Wikipedia says quadrangular, kept as sometimes.

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbage glabrous or lightly puberulent, the hairs often in 2 lines; FOC: glabrous or slightly pubescent.

traits.crown_form.note: Wikipedia, Mirabilis jalapa (read 2026-10-19; lower trust): a bushy, much-branched plant; a rounded clump read from that (FOC: much branched).

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves opposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Nyctaginaceae (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): opposite, decussate pairs (family).

traits.leaf_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flat blades.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Nyctaginaceae (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaf blade simple.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petioles at midstem 1-7 cm; FOC: 1-4 cm; upper leaves short-stalked or sessile (sect. Mirabilis).

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 4-14 cm long; FOC vol. 5: 3-15 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 2-9 cm wide; FOC the same.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade usually deltate-ovate, oblong-ovate or broadly lanceolate, the base cordate to obtuse; FOC: ovate or ovate-triangular, base truncate or cordate (cordate kept as sometimes, since the vocabulary puts a lobed base in the shape).

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): apex acuminate.

traits.leaf_base_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): base truncate or cordate; FNA: cordate to obtuse.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margin entire.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): the herb glabrous or slightly pubescent; blades glabrous (FNA: herbage glabrous or lightly puberulent).

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: plain mid green; no source names the leaf colour; sRGB by eye.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis sect. Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): compact cymes in the upper axils and terminal, each involucre with 1 flower.

traits.inflorescence_unit.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis sect. Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): single flowers, each in its own involucre.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Wikipedia, Mirabilis jalapa (read 2026-10-19; lower trust): inflorescences of 3-7 flowers; FOC: flowers usually several, clustered at branch tips.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers usually several clustered at the tips of branches; FNA: also in the upper axils.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): peduncle 0.5-5 mm.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicel 1-2 mm.

traits.bract_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): involucre herbaceous (green, calyx-like).

traits.inflorescence_bracts.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): involucre of 5 bracts, 40-60% connate; FOC: campanulate, 5-lobed.

traits.bract_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): involucral bracts 5-12 mm in flower, 7-15(-17) mm in fruit; FOC: involucre about 1 cm.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): showy petaloid perianth, no corolla.

traits.perianth_fused.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perianth a tube 2-6 cm under a spreading limb.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): limb salverform (FNA sect. Mirabilis: long funnelform, tube narrow, limb abruptly flared): a narrow tube with a flat limb.

traits.corolla_tube_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): tube 2-6 cm; FNA: perianth (2-)3.5-5 cm overall.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): limb 2.5-3 cm across.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): limb 5-lobed.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): perianth usually rose-pink, sometimes yellow, rarely white or variegated; FOC: purple, red, yellow, white or variegated. sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 5, filaments slender, exserted.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): filaments exserted.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Nyctaginaceae (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 1-carpellate.

traits.ovary_position.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Nyctaginaceae (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): ovary superior, enclosed in the perianth base.

traits.flower_posture.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: the long tubes rise at a slant from the involucres at the branch tips.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruit (anthocarp) dark brown to nearly black, smooth or obscurely rugose or tuberculate; read as achene.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits 7-11 mm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruit 5-8 mm across.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): broadly ellipsoid to slightly obovoid, round or bluntly 5-angled in section; FOC: globose.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits dark brown to nearly black; FOC: black. sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.fruit_colour_ripening.note: Wikipedia, Mirabilis jalapa (read 2026-10-19; lower trust): fruits greenish yellow before turning black. sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): the involucre persists and grows a little, 7-15(-17) mm in fruit; the perianth base stays as the fruit wall while the limb falls (FOC: deciduous limb).

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering summer to early fall in North America (year-round elsewhere); FOC: June-October.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruiting August-November.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 0-1000 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): to 1000 m in the flora (2800 m outside it).

traits.light.note: Wikipedia, Mirabilis jalapa (read 2026-10-19; lower trust): does best in full sun.

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 4, Mirabilis jalapa var. jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): roadsides, old fields, fence rows, waste areas; introduced; native to Mexico.

traits.habit_notes.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Mirabilis jalapa (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): nodes inflated; flowers open late afternoon, close next morning; FNA root to 20 kg; Wikipedia: flowers of different colours on one plant, sectors, flakes and spots.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: a stem to 1 m forking repeatedly, with opposite pairs a few cm apart.

traits.flowering_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: FNA: stems much branched, the flowers clustered at the branch tips.

traits.flowering_branch_orders.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: the stems fork again and again (FNA: much branched), so the side branches branch once more.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: a terminal cluster of 3-6 flowers in their involucres, about as long as a flower tube.
